Tagline: Why is this running? Trace process, port, container or file
Description: ps, top and lsof tell you what is running. witr tells you why. Run it bare for an interactive TUI with Processes, Ports, Containers and Locks tabs. Or script it: –short for a one-line chain, –json with real exit codes.
